label: Opening Hook
text: Seen from space, a 40-kilometre bullseye in the Sahara looks like a giant eye, and it was made by geology, not people.

label: Terrain & Scale
text: About 40 km (25 miles) across, in Mauritania's Adrar region Geologists explain it as an uplifted, eroded geological dome, not an impact crater A well-known landmark for astronauts Claims linking it to Atlantis are not supported by geology or archaeology Prehistoric stone tools found in the area show people lived nearby
